notes: Three date-and-time corrections carried over from the portal audit. Regularizing an attendance row from the monthly screen used to open — and save to — the day BEFORE the one tapped for anyone using it before 5:30 am; My Roster's thirty-day window started a day early for the same reason; and My Approvals printed hours as a raw decimal (8.53) where every other screen says 8h 32m. Everything from the previous releases is included: correcting a punch time is the Backend's alone and is audited, your own details are editable from the Profile tab, a loan or advance request carries its repayment plan, and the menu matches the web portal. This needs the matching server update to be live.
